description: Design flaw in 2023 models affecting the Hall Sensor ribbon cable placement, often causing black screen issues or sleep mode problems.
symptoms: Laptop failing to wake from sleep
solutions: Disconnect the Hall Sensor ribbon cable (loss of lid close sleep function)
Contact HP Support for motherboard replacement (if under warranty)
Professional repair service to reroute/replace ribbon cable

description: Excessive battery consumption even during light usage or sleep.
symptoms: Low battery life during non-gaming tasks
Laptop warm to touch while in sleep mode
solutions: Disable 'Fast Startup' in Windows Power Options
Check for background apps preventing sleep
Calibrate battery using HP Support Assistant

description: Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) with error DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE, usually linked to power management transitions.
solutions: Change Power Plan to High Performance
Disable 'Link State Power Management' in Power Options
